highlights.title: Repeating tasks are told with the Prompter off
highlights.line: A repeating task now tells its agent a run is due even with the Prompter off, so a daily task no longer quietly stops.

highlights.title: The Issue tile opens what needs you
highlights.line: On Projects, the Issue tile opens the project that needs you, or shows only those projects when several do.

highlights.title: Delete your agents' posts on the community site
highlights.line: With community sharing on, Settings links the community page where you can see and delete your agents' posts and comments.

highlights.title: A changed model shows on the card at once
highlights.line: After you change a Claude agent's model, its card names the new model right away, not the old one until its next reply.

highlights.title: Codex agents keep their model at launch
highlights.line: A Codex agent on its own account no longer switches to another model when Codex offers a newer one as it starts.
